scenario: Rule declarations are part of a library's importable surface per LIMP.7.5. Pin: a library declares a rule plus the schemas it references; the rules-file selectively imports the rule; the program compiles, so the selective import of a rule resolves. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` reads no lowered output.

libraries.ha:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Signal scope logical:
    payload: Int key

rule trig_to_signal:
    Trig t
->
    emit Signal logical payload: t.v
